description:
Create Filament-owned copies of the Phoenix tag engine infrastructure so subsequent tickets can modify code-gen freely.

READ FIRST:
- deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/tag_engine.ex
- deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/html_engine.ex
- lib/filament/html_engine.ex  (current thin wrapper — will be replaced)
- lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex  (line 37: the TagEngine call to update)
- lib/filament/sigil_f.ex  (entry point, no changes needed here)

STEPS:

1. Copy deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/tag_engine.ex
   to lib/filament/tag_engine.ex.
   Change the module declaration to: defmodule Filament.TagEngine
   Remove or comment the @moduledoc if it references Phoenix.
   Do not change any logic yet — this ticket is pure copy + wire.

2. Replace lib/filament/html_engine.ex entirely with a copy of
   deps/phoenix_live_view/lib/phoenix_live_view/html_engine.ex.
   Change the module declaration to: defmodule Filament.HTMLEngine
   Remove @behaviour Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine (it now satisfies
   Filament.TagEngine callbacks implicitly).
   Preserve the on_click/on_submit → phx-click/phx-submit transform
   from the OLD lib/filament/html_engine.ex — migrate the
   transform_event_pair/1 logic and the handle_attributes/2 override
   into the new file. The old file calls Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLEngine.handle_attributes/2
   after transforming; the new file IS HTMLEngine, so apply the transform
   directly in handle_attributes/2 before the rest of the function body.

3. In lib/filament/vnode_compiler.ex, change line 37:
   FROM: Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine.compile(source, ...
   TO:   Filament.TagEngine.compile(source, ...
   Keep all other options unchanged (file:, line:, caller:, indentation:, tag_handler:).
   Remove the sanitized_caller workaround (lines 31-34 and 34 usage) — the
   forked TagEngine will not have the maybe_warn_taint check that required it.
   Pass caller directly.

4. Verify the forked TagEngine compiles: run `mix compile`. Fix any module
   references inside the forked files that point to Phoenix.LiveView.TagEngine
   or Phoenix.LiveView.HTMLEngine — update them to Filament.TagEngine and
   Filament.HTMLEngine respectively. Internal calls within each file are
   already correct (same module).

ACCEPTANCE:
- `mix test` passes with no new failures
- `cd examples/todo && mix phx.server` starts; navigate Chrome to localhost:4000
- Add two todos, verify both appear; toggle one, verify strikethrough; click filter tabs, verify filtering
title: Fork Filament.TagEngine and Filament.HTMLEngine; wire VNodeCompiler to use them
